qs.p: 用 LINE 通知外師 Sarah：縣府宣布明天颱風停課，請她在家注意安全。
a: Hi Sarah, just a heads-up: the county has canceled classes tomorrow because of the typhoon. No need to come in. Stay safe and stay indoors!
Dear Sarah, according to the announcement of the county government, tomorrow stop working and stop class. Please be careful at home.
Sarah, tomorrow no school. Don't come.
qs.n: 好的通知要有三件事：發生什麼事、她要做什麼、一句關心。第二則是公文直譯，第三則太冷淡。

qs.p: 用 Email 請外師 Mike 在本週五前，交居留證正反面影本（要辦保險用）。
a: Hi Mike, could you send me a copy of your ARC (front and back) by this Friday? We need it for your insurance paperwork. Thanks so much!
Mike, you MUST give me the ARC copy before Friday or there will be a problem.
Dear Mike, please kindly provide your ARC photocopy before Friday for the insurance procedure. Thank you for your cooperation.
qs.n: 說明「為什麼要」（for your insurance paperwork），對方比較願意配合。please kindly 加 thank you for your cooperation 是很僵硬的公文腔；全大寫的 MUST 像在吼人。

qs.p: 提醒外師 Rachel：下週三第三節要觀課，並說明流程。
a: Hi Rachel, just a reminder that your class observation is next Wednesday, 3rd period. The observers will sit in the back for the whole lesson, and afterward we'll have a 20-minute debrief in the English room. Feel free to send me your lesson plan by Monday if you'd like feedback beforehand.
Rachel, next Wednesday people will come to watch you. Prepare well and don't make mistakes.
Rachel, observation Wed 3rd period. Lesson plan Mon.
qs.n: 流程講清楚，對方就不會焦慮。Feel free to… if you'd like 是提供協助，不是命令。

qs.p: 群組通知所有外師：週四的會議從兩點改到三點半，地點不變。
a: Hi all, quick update: Thursday's meeting has been moved from 2:00 to 3:30, same room. Sorry for the change, and thanks for your flexibility!
All, Thursday meeting time change, 3:30, please be on time.
Hi all, there is a change regarding the time of the meeting that will be held on Thursday, and the new time will be announced later.
qs.n: 改時間的通知要同時寫「舊時間→新時間」，避免有人看錯。Thanks for your flexibility 是體貼的收尾。第三則根本沒給新時間。

qs.p: 提醒外師 Mark：五月是報稅期，並提議幫他上網申報。
a: Hi Mark, just a friendly reminder that Taiwan's income tax filing period is in May. If you'd like, I can help you file online this Friday after school.
Mark, you must pay tax in May or you will go to jail.
Mark, tax. May.
qs.n: a friendly reminder 讓提醒聽起來不像催討。主動提出幫忙，再給具體時間。

qs.p: 外師 Lisa 生病請假，回覆她：表達關心，並說代課已經安排好。
a: Oh no, feel better soon, Lisa! Don't worry about your classes. I've arranged a sub for tomorrow. Just send me a photo of your doctor's note when you can.
Lisa, are you sick again? Please give me the doctor's proof.
Lisa, OK, rest.
qs.n: 先關心人，再講事務。when you can 讓她不必急著處理文件。

qs.p: 用 Email 感謝外師 David 幫忙英語日的闖關活動。
a: Hi David, thank you so much for all your help with English Day! The students had a blast at your station, and several teachers told me how well organized everything was. We really appreciate it.
David, thank you for your paying out in English Day, you are very hard.
David, English Day finished. Thanks.
qs.n: 具體說出好在哪裡（學生玩得很開心、老師稱讚），感謝才有份量。had a blast＝玩得超開心。

qs.p: 外師 Jessica 忘了來開會，傳訊息道歉。回覆她，並告訴她會後補資料給她。
a: No worries at all, Jessica! I'll fill you in on what we covered. The main thing was the English Day schedule. I'll send you the notes this afternoon.
Jessica, you forgot the meeting. Everyone was waiting for you.
Never mind, it wasn't important anyway.
qs.n: fill you in＝跟你補充說明。第三則看似寬容，其實在說「會議不重要」，反而不妥。

qs.p: 邀請外師 Jason 參加下週二三點半、在圖書館舉辦的教師節慶祝會。
a: Hi Jason, our school is holding a small Teachers' Day celebration next Tuesday at 3:30 in the library. We'd love for you to join us. There'll be snacks and a short performance by the students!
Jason, next Tuesday there is a Teachers' Day activity. Everyone must attend.
Dear Mr. Jason, we sincerely invite you to attend our honorable Teachers' Day celebration activity.
qs.n: We'd love for you to join us 是溫暖的邀請。Mr. 後面要接姓，不能接名（Mr. Smith，不是 Mr. Jason）。

qs.p: 外師 Emily 早上遲到被校長注意到，妳要委婉提醒她。
a: Hi Emily, hope your week's going well! Just a quick note: the principal mentioned that class started a bit late this morning. I know mornings can be hectic, but could you aim to be in the classroom by 8:40? Let me know if anything is making that hard.
Emily, the principal is very angry because you were late. Don't be late again.
Emily, you were late. The principal saw.
qs.n: 「三明治」寫法：先問候，再講事實（不誇大成很生氣），然後提出明確期待，最後給對方說明的空間。

qs.p: 外師 Amy 想在段考週請假去旅行，學校不能核准。回覆她。
a: Hi Amy, thanks for asking ahead of time. Unfortunately, we can't approve personal leave during exam week, since all teachers need to be on campus. Would the following weekend work for your trip instead?
Amy, no. You cannot take leave during exam week.
Amy, we will research it and let you know.
qs.n: 拒絕要說原因，再給替代方案。第三則看似委婉，其實會讓她以為還有機會，反而更麻煩。

qs.p: 外師 Kevin 問這個月薪水為什麼還沒入帳。說明是連假的關係，週三前會入帳。
a: Hi Kevin, sorry for the delay! This month's pay is a few days late because of the holiday, but it should be in your account by Wednesday. I'll let you know as soon as it's deposited.
Kevin, late salary is normal in Taiwan. Please wait patiently.
Kevin, I don't know. Ask accounting.
qs.n: 跟錢有關的事，外師會很焦慮。先道歉，說明原因，給明確日期，再承諾會通知。

qs.p: 外師 Chris 問明年會不會續聘，但結果還沒確定。
a: Hi Chris, great question. The renewal decisions haven't been finalized yet. I'll let you know the moment I hear anything.
Chris, maybe yes, maybe no. Don't ask.
Chris, of course you will be renewed. Don't worry.
qs.n: 還沒確定的事不要替學校承諾（第三則），否則日後很難收拾。誠實說還沒決定，並承諾會第一時間通知。

qs.p: 外師 Tom 反映宿舍熱水器壞了。回覆他：已經報修，師傅明天下午會來。
a: Hi Tom, so sorry about the hot water! I've reported it to the General Affairs Office, and a repair person should come by tomorrow afternoon. Will someone be home, or would you like me to arrange a time?
Tom, the broken water heater is not my business. Please call the landlord.
Tom, OK.
qs.n: come by＝過來一趟。最後問一句方便的時間，讓事情真的能解決。

qs.p: 有位家長想跟外師 Anna 談談孩子的英文學習，請妳幫忙約時間，妳也會在場翻譯。
a: Hi Anna, one of your students' parents would like to meet with you briefly to talk about how their child is doing in English. Would Tuesday or Thursday after school work for you? I'll be there to interpret.
Anna, a parent wants to complain about you. Come on Tuesday.
Anna, a parent wants to see you.
qs.n: 說明面談目的，外師才不會緊張。給兩個時間讓她選，並告訴她妳會在場。

qs.p: 請外師 Ben 幫忙校對校園英文標語，週五前完成即可。
a: Hi Ben, would you have a few minutes to proofread the English on our new campus signs? I've attached the list. No rush. Anytime before Friday would be great. Thank you!
Ben, please check this English quickly, today.
Ben, attached. Check.
qs.n: proofread＝校對。No rush 加上期限，對方會覺得被尊重，也知道時程。
